name: Opal Size Charts for WooCommerce
author: wpopal

sections.description:
Opal Size Charts for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that allows you to add, manage, and display size charts for your WooCommerce products. With an intuitive interface, you can create unlimited size charts, assign them to specific products or categories, and customize their appearance to match your store’s branding. This helps customers make informed purchasing decisions, improves user experience, and reduces product returns.

Features

  • Create unlimited size charts
  • Assign size charts to individual products or categories
  • Display size charts on product pages with customizable placement
  • User-friendly interface for managing charts
  • Support for tables, images, and custom HTML in charts
  • Responsive design for mobile devices
  • Import/export size charts
  • Shortcode support for manual placement
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes

Benefits

  • Enhances customer confidence and satisfaction
  • Reduces product returns due to sizing issues
  • Saves time for store administrators
  • Improves overall shopping experience
sections.installation:
1. Unzip the downloaded zip file.
  2. Upload the plugin folder into the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress site.
  3. Activate the plugin ‘Opal Size Charts for WooCommerce‘ from the Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Can I assign different size charts to different products?

Yes, you can assign specific size charts to individual products or categories.

Can I customize the look of the size charts?

Absolutely. You can edit the content, layout, and style of each size chart to fit your store’s design.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

The plugin is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.
